Royal Bank Of Scotland Group Plc increased its stake in Gilead Sciences Inc (GILD) by 1.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Royal Bank Of Scotland Group Plc bought 5,108 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.93% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 268,417 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.23M, up from 263,309 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Royal Bank Of Scotland Group Plc who had been investing in Gilead Sciences Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $84.44 billion market cap company.
